pages.title: python -m installer
pages.observation: CLI RECORD validation defaults to none; request all for full validation. Bytecode compilation defaults to levels0,1; no-compile-bytecode disables it. Existing-file overwrite defaults false. Wheel paths and prefix are interface inputs, not confinement guarantees.

pages.title: installer.sources
pages.observation: WheelFile.validate_record(validate_contents=True) validates membership and content sizes/hashes. Documentation directs callers to run validation before install when needed. API may change in patch versions; stable docs do not pin implementation.

pages.title: installer.destinations
pages.observation: Destination methods generate entrypoint scripts and installed RECORD. SchemeDictionaryDestination takes explicit interpreter/scheme/script-kind; defaults include SHA256, empty bytecode levels and no overwrite. This documents interfaces, not quota, path-race or target-import isolation.

hash_scope: Per-observation hashes below bind canonical retained semantic metadata, never originHTML bytes, source archives, released code or a version attestation.
